_llm_instructions: Fill in the 'project_title' and 'date_prepared' properties, and the 'value' property of each field, based on the provided project context. Reference parameters.md for global project variables.

f01_Sprint_or_Iteration.label: Sprint or Iteration
f01_Sprint_or_Iteration.guidance: The sprint or iteration this retrospective covers. A retrospective that does not say which sprint it belongs to cannot be compared with the previous one, and an uncountable sequence of retrospectives is the same as none.

f02_Team_Members_Present.label: Team Members Present
f02_Team_Members_Present.guidance: Who took part. Someone who is not in the room cannot act on what was agreed, so name the absent members and how the outcome will reach them.

f03_Date.label: Date
f03_Date.guidance: The date the retrospective was held.

f04_Start.label: Start
f04_Start.guidance: Actions and behaviors the team will begin to implement. Be specific: "hold a joint review with QA twice a week" can be started, "communicate better" cannot.

f05_Stop.label: Stop
f05_Stop.guidance: Actions or behaviors the team will cease doing. If the team is not willing to actually stop it, recording it here only builds a list the team learns to distrust.

f06_Keep.label: Keep
f06_Keep.guidance: Practices the team should continue with. Note why, because the reason is what a future team will need when the person who introduced the practice has moved on.

f07_More.label: More
f07_More.guidance: Practices that were not done consistently and should be done more often. Inconsistent usually means the practice exists but nothing enforces it, so record what would enforce it.

f08_Less.label: Less
f08_Less.guidance: Practices that were done too much or should be reduced. Watch for process that exists to fix a problem which no longer occurs; that is the usual source of ceremony the team has stopped noticing.

f09_Action.label: Action
f09_Action.guidance: The specific change being made, taken from the Start, Stop, More, and Less columns rather than invented separately.

f10_Owner.label: Owner
f10_Owner.guidance: The one person accountable for making it happen. A team cannot own an action, because a team is never available.

f11_By_When.label: By When
f11_By_When.guidance: The date it should be done, and where it will be reviewed. An action with no review date is an action that will be carried into the next retrospective as a note about doing it better.

f12_Outcome.label: Outcome
f12_Outcome.guidance: What happened when it was tried, filled in at the next retrospective. Without this column the team repeats the same actions and the retrospective becomes a ritual rather than a feedback loop.

f13_Future_Considerations.label: Future Considerations
f13_Future_Considerations.guidance: The FLAP alternative to the starfish. If the team prefers FLAP, replace the five starfish columns with Accomplishments, Problems, Lessons, and Future Considerations rather than recording both, since two parallel forms get half-filled and neither is trusted.
